channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: IMF Urges Members to Bolster Funds for Vulnerable Nations
item.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged its member countries to increase financial resources to support low-income and vulnerable states. This call comes as the US Treasury Secretary emphasized the need for a stronger IMF role in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Inflation Rises Ahead of Midterm Elections
item.description: Inflation in the United States increased at a faster pace than anticipated in the latest report released before the midterm elections. This economic indicator is a significant concern for voters heading into the elections. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway Acquires 4% Stake in Bending Spoons
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway has increased its stake in Bending Spoons to 4%, a move that saw the Italian software company's stock surge by 41%. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Sam Wood's fitness platform has been involved in disputes and lawsuits during its growth into a major health business. The Sydney Morning Herald reported on these issues. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delta Air Lines to Offer Free In-Flight Wi-Fi on Australian Flights
item.description: Delta Air Lines is set to introduce free in-flight Wi-Fi on all its Australian flights within weeks. The airline will offer this service across its entire Australian network. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australia's Trust Tax Overhaul Expected to Raise $40 Billion
item.description: Australia's Labor government is proceeding with a trust tax overhaul that is projected to generate $40 billion. Businesses have expressed concerns about potential accounting turmoil resulting from the changes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Firm Anthropic Plans Pre-IPO Investor Day Amid Listing Plans
item.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is reportedly planning a pre-IPO investor day as it nears a potential stock market listing. The event is expected to focus on the company's growth strategies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Brazil's Congress has approved a bill reducing the standard workweek from 44 to 40 hours, mandating two paid days off instead of the current one. The measure, which the government had been advocating for months, received support from… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Aegis Logistics to acquire 89.8% stake in Tristar for ₹7700 crore
item.description: Aegis Logistics has entered into an agreement to acquire an 89.8% stake in Dubai-based Tristar for ₹7700 crore. Tristar Group has signed the agreement for Aegis Logistics to become its majority shareholder. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Global technology hardware stocks, particularly in the AI and chip sectors, continued their decline on Thursday. Asian chipmakers followed a downward trend set by their US counterparts, driven by concerns over potential interest rate hikes… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Bengal Government Warns Industries on Land Use or Face Surrender
item.description: The West Bengal government has issued an ultimatum to industries, demanding they utilize allotted land or surrender it for reallocation to other investors. This directive aims to ensure efficient use of industrial land within the state. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) has approved the largest financial sector Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) deal, allowing Fairfax India Holdings to acquire a majority stake in IDBI Bank. This move signifies a significant… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Centre Considers Stricter FDI Rules for Tobacco Sector
item.description: The Indian government is reportedly considering stricter Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) norms for the tobacco sector, including a potential ban on brand licensing agreements. This move aims to curb foreign investment in the industry. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Flipkart Sales Offer Discounts on Smartphones and Laptops
item.description: Flipkart's Big Billion Days 2026 sale is offering smartphones, including the Nothing Phone 4a and Poco X8 Pro, at prices under ₹40,000. Additionally, ASUS laptops are available with discounts of up to ₹21,000, starting from ₹49,990. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: The Indian government has proposed new Bharat Stage (BS)-VII emission standards, slated to be implemented in three phases starting April 2029. These proposed norms will extend beyond engine emissions to include regulations for brake and… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: Salaries in India are projected to increase by 9.1% in 2027, according to a survey. The survey also aims to identify which sectors will experience the largest pay increases. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: LVMH reported a slight increase in overall sales, despite a downturn in its fashion and leather goods division during the third quarter. This performance has cast a shadow over the fragile recovery of the luxury sector, dashing hopes for a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.description: Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL) has secured new orders totaling ₹2,225 crore. These orders are for its Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business and are spread across both Indian and overseas markets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.description: Bumble is set to go private in a $1.3 billion deal with Ithaca Holdings, as reported on October 13. The company has struggled to revive growth due to a prolonged decline in users and shifting dating habits among Gen Z, which have impacted… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.description: JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs have reported significant increases in their quarterly profits. Goldman Sachs exceeded profit estimates, driven by strength in its equities division. JPMorgan Chase also saw its profits jump. These strong… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 16 · Right 0.

item.title: Africa's Energy Wealth vs. Lack of Power Access
item.description: Despite Africa's vast energy resources, approximately 560 million people on the continent currently lack access to power. This disparity highlights a significant challenge in energy infrastructure financing and distribution across Africa. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Lufthansa has won a competitive process to acquire a stake in TAP Air Portugal. The German airline emerged victorious in the contest for the Portuguese carrier. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Stocks Decline Amid Worsening Inflation Concerns
item.description: US stocks have fallen further from their record highs as inflation continues to worsen. Trading on Wall Street has been mixed, with stocks hovering near their latest record. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 10 · Right 0.
